standard-dialogue.npc: Hello there. I'd be careful of upsetting the gryphons in here. These ones so far don't seem to be too aggressive. We'd prefer to keep it that way.
You can, but only if you have permission. We still want to keep them in check, but we don't want to go overboard and make them angry.

standard-dialogue.text: You can only fight the gryphons in this cave if you've been assigned to kill them by a Slayer Master.

attempting-to-attack-without-task.text: Elder Kelmo wants you to stick to your Slayer assignments.

attempting-to-attack-without-task.npc: Wait! These gryphons do not currently pose a threat to us. You shouldn't attack them without permission!
